name: Colleges and universities (admin)

problems.words: Admission enquiries peak for six weeks and we can't call everyone back
quick_ideas: Split enquiries by programme between named counsellors, so no enquiry is everyone's job
Put the questions applicants ask most onto your website, so counsellors spend their time on real conversations.

workzap_build.text: Every enquiry and application captured by source, programme and counsellor, with automatic follow-up reminders and a daily funnel view per programme and campus.

problems.ask_first: Where do most applications start — website, social, walk-in or agents?
problems.free_stops: The counsellor assignment rules and funnel stages are kept for the document.

problems.words: Applicants fill the form but drop off before paying the admission fee
quick_ideas: Try the payment step yourself on a phone, so you see where applicants get stuck
Contact this week's stalled applicants once, using the number they applied with, so you learn why they stopped.

workzap_build.text: Stalled applications spotted every day and reminded on a timed sequence until the fee is paid or the applicant opts out, with drop-off measured per programme.

problems.free_stops: The reminder timings and drop-off reasons tracking are in the document.

problems.words: Installment students fall behind and finance only notices at exams
quick_ideas: Pull a list of installment accounts past due today, by account number, so finance sees the size of it now
Agree a mid-semester checkpoint with the registrar, so overdue accounts surface long before admit cards.

workzap_build.text: An installment tracker that sends due-date reminders automatically and gives finance a weekly early-warning list, with account numbers instead of names in owner reports.

problems.free_stops: The reminder sequence and early-warning thresholds are kept for the document.

problems.words: Fee payments come through several banks and matching takes days
quick_ideas: Make the fee reference number required on every challan and transfer, so each payment can be traced
Keep one list of unmatched receipts, so students can clear their own cases.

workzap_build.text: integration — Reference numbers from every bank matched to fee accounts daily, with unmatched receipts flagged each morning.

problems.free_stops: How each bank's statement is read and matched is set out in the document.

problems.words: Scholarship and discount approvals sit with three people for weeks
quick_ideas: Find out who is holding each pending file right now, so stuck ones get moving
Hold one fixed weekly approval slot, so files don't wait for a free moment.

workzap_build.text: One timestamped approval trail for scholarships, discounts and refunds, showing approvers only what they need and measuring turnaround per office.

problems.free_stops: The approval routing and turnaround targets are kept for the document.

problems.words: Visiting faculty claims don't match the timetable
quick_ideas: Check this month's claims against the published timetable before paying, so you see where the gaps are
Set one claim deadline per month, so late claims stop piling up.

workzap_build.text: Every claim checked automatically against the timetable and lecture logs before payment, with differences flagged per department.

problems.free_stops: The matching rules for swaps, make-up lectures and cancellations are in the document.

problems.words: Room clashes show up in week one
quick_ideas: Let one person control room bookings, so double bookings have one source
Share the draft timetable with faculty early, so clashes are reported before term.

workzap_build.text: A timetable and room tool that checks every change for clashes before anything is published.

problems.free_stops: The clash rules and room-capacity logic are kept for the document.

problems.words: Add/drop changes don't reach finance, so fee bills are wrong
quick_ideas: Send finance the list of this term's add/drop changes once, so this term's bills can be corrected
Hold fee bills until add/drop closes, so they go out right the first time.

workzap_build.text: Registrar records and the fee system connected so course changes update fee bills automatically, every day of the add/drop window.

problems.free_stops: Which fields sync and how exceptions are handled is in the document.

problems.words: Transcript and verification requests pile up for weeks
quick_ideas: Count the requests waiting today and sort them by type, so you know where the backlog is
Process the most common type in one batch, so the pile drops fast.

workzap_build.text: Every request given a reference, tracked to completion and measured for turnaround, with automatic status updates to the requester.

problems.free_stops: The request stages and status messages are kept for the document.

problems.words: Board reports are compiled by hand from every office
quick_ideas: Agree with the board the fixed list of numbers it wants, so offices stop guessing
Give every office the same date to send them, so the report comes together on time.

workzap_build.text: One board screen filled daily from source data, showing enrolment, collections, dropouts and costs by campus and programme.

problems.free_stops: How each office's data feeds the screen is set out in the document.

never_say: Anything about student visas, study permits or immigration status; pi notes only the letter-processing workload.
Advice on accreditation, HEC, CAA/MOE or ministry decisions, or degree equivalence.
Employment-law or refund-law guidance; pi says "talk to your lawyer".
Any idea that asks for student names, IDs, CGPA, transcripts or financial-aid circumstances.
Help issuing, backdating or altering degrees, transcripts, attendance or enrolment letters.
Promises about enrolment numbers or collections.

sample_reply.person: Can you suggest a fix for installment students? Finance finds out who hasn't paid only when admit cards are being printed.
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be caught much earlier, and you can start this week. 1) Pull today's list of installment accounts past due, by account number only, so finance sees the real size of it. 2) Agree a mid-semester checkpoint with the registrar, so overdue accounts come up long before exams. Workzap can do this automatically for you, with reminders on every due date and a weekly early-warning list for finance. Would you like me to arrange a solution document and quote for you? You're welcome to say no.
